content: claude.ai/new?q= on the WEB is not documented by Anthropic. Officially documented: desktop deep link claude://claude.ai/new?q=... (prefill only, user must send, q truncated to ~14,000 chars; support article 14729294, updated 2026-06-30) and mobile universal links for claude.ai/code/new?q=. Unofficial sources (austegard.com Feb 2026, third-party link generators) say https://claude.ai/new?q= prefills the composer on web, subject to a prefill safety check that can show an untrusted-prompt modal; auto-submit via URL stopped working in Oct 2025 (GitHub anthropics/claude-code#8827, closed not planned). Treat as best-effort prefill with clipboard fallback; never rely on auto-submit.
